title: Frontend: GitHub connect flow in project settings — OAuth, repo selection
description: GitHub integration section in project settings. If not connected, shows a Connect button. If connected, shows repo name and disconnect option.
acceptanceCriteria: If user has no GitHub access token: shows 'Connect GitHub Account' button → redirects to /api/auth/github/repo
If user has GitHub token but project has no repo: shows repo search/select input, fetches user's repos, allows linking
If project has repo linked: shows repo name with 'Disconnect' button

steps.details: Create src/components/project/GithubConnectPanel.tsx. Conditional rendering based on user.githubConnected and project.githubRepoName state.

When GitHub is connected but no repo linked: fetch /api/users/me/github/repos (add this endpoint to get user's repos list via Octokit). Show a searchable Select dropdown. On select: POST /api/projects/:id/github/connect with { repoOwner, repoName }.
Show: GitHub logo, repo name as a link, 'X commits imported' count, 'Disconnect' button. Disconnect: calls DELETE endpoint, invalidates project query.
Connect GitHub account. Select a repo. Verify commits import. Disconnect — verify repo removed. Reconnect with different repo.
